title: Cadence, noise learn, and alignment tests
description:
Add focused Catch2 (or existing project test harness) unit tests covering CadenceTracker, NoiseFloorEstimator, AlignmentAnalyzer, and FractionalDelay.

Before editing, inspect:
- tests/TestMain.cpp and existing tests/* patterns from prior phases
- Source/DSP/CadenceTracker.*, NoiseFloorEstimator.*, AlignmentAnalyzer.*, FractionalDelay.* public APIs
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md sections 11–13 formulas under test
- CMakeLists.txt test target registration from e.4 (do not re-own CMake — prefer zero CMake edits)

Implement tests/CadenceTests.cpp:
1) Interval median: regularly spaced synthetic onsets yield I near the true spacing within a small tolerance; introduce one outlier interval and assert robust median stays near the regular spacing.
2) Release constraint: with known I and factor c, tau_release_max = c*I and tau_release_eff = min(tau_manual, tau_release_max) for tau_manual above and below the cap.
3) Mode Off: returns tau_manual unchanged / constraint inactive.
4) Insufficient history: isEstimateValid false (or equivalent) until minimum onset count collected.
5) NoiseFloorEstimator path in this file OR cross-included cases: idle noise capture produces floor below a louder tone; percentile floor rises when observation buffer is ivory-noise-floor elevated; applySuggestions does not run until explicitly called — assert hasSuggestions after learn and that getters for suggestions are populated; slow-adapt rejected when not closed / transient flag set (if exposed).

Implement tests/AlignmentTests.cpp:
1) FractionalDelay: impulse delayed by integer samples appears at expected index; fractional delay (e.g. 1.3 samples) produces interpolated energy spanning neighboring taps (Lagrange), not pure zeros.
2) FractionalDelay: setDelayMs within ±25 ms at fs=48000 is stable and process of silence stays near zero after reset.
3) AlignmentAnalyzer: synthetic key onset leading audio by a known sample offset yields recommended delay near that offset (sign per API: delay key when DI leads) within documented sample/ms tolerance after calibration/analysis call.
4) Correlation confidence higher for clearly aligned repeated onsets than for uncorrelated noise pair fixtures.
5) Calibration gate: recommended delay not committed until acceptAlignment (or equivalent) if API separates recommend vs accepted.

Keep tests deterministic (fixed SR e.g. 48000, fixed lengths, explicit tolerances). No audio hardware. Noise-learn coverage may live primarily in CadenceTests.cpp alongside cadence cases if that matches CMake registration of only CadenceTests + AlignmentTests; ensure NoiseFloorEstimator is exercised in at least one registered test case.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: tests/CadenceTests.cpp exists and registers multiple test cases covering CadenceTracker
tests/CadenceTests.cpp or tests/AlignmentTests.cpp registers test cases covering NoiseFloorEstimator learn/percentile/suggestion behavior
tests/AlignmentTests.cpp exists and registers multiple test cases covering AlignmentAnalyzer and FractionalDelay
CadenceTracker tests assert robust median interval and tau_release_eff = min(tau_manual, c*I)
CadenceTracker tests assert Off mode leaves manual release unconstrained
NoiseFloorEstimator tests assert capture produces suggestions only after learn and floors respond to observation level
FractionalDelay tests assert integer delay placement and non-trivial fractional Lagrange interpolation behavior
AlignmentAnalyzer tests assert recovered delay near a known synthetic key-leads-audio offset within stated tolerance
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/* production DSP implementations except via test includes
add non-JUCE third-party test frameworks not already used by the project
network access or non-deterministic timing assertions

allowed: use the existing test framework from tests/TestMain.cpp
synthetic onset grids, noise floors, delayed impulses, and onset-pair fixtures at a fixed sample rate (e.g. 48000)
relative ms/sample/score tolerances rather than bit-exact equality
place NoiseFloorEstimator cases in CadenceTests.cpp if only two test files are registered

require real audio hardware or host sidechain
